newsitem.title: USA: Idan Software Q1 net loss widens.
newsitem.headline: Idan Software Q1 net loss widens.

text.p: Adjusted New Israeli Shekels into U.S. Dollars

NOTE: Idan Software Industries-I.S.I. Ltd said its net loss for the first quarter of 1997 included a loss from continuing operations of NIS 317,000 (US$ 94,000), or NIS 0.01 (US$ 0.003) per share, and a loss from discontinued telecommunications operations of NIS 1,394,000 (US$ 415,000), or NIS 0.05 (US$ 0.014) per share.

Net loss for the first quarter of 1996 included a loss from continuing operations of NIS 413,000 (US$ 123,000), or NIS 0.014 (US$ .004) per share, and a loss from discontinued operations of NIS 181,000 (US$ 54,000), or NIS 0.006 (US$ 0.002) per share.
All U.S. dollar figures represent an exchange rate of NIS 3.361 to US$ 1.00 at March 31, 1997.
